title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-tyler-johnson-2026-03-16
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep for weekly sync with Tyler Johnson (AE)
Date/time: 2026-03-17 10:00am PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / channel: #cs-atlasfin
Goal: Align on AtlasFin account health, prep for Wed A/C/SM touchpoint, confirm renewal posture and next steps to unblock Dedicated capacity request.

Top priorities to cover:
- Renewal posture (Q3 2026): target renewal conversation window: 2026-04-15 to 2026-05-01. Revenue at-risk if we don't close Dedicated sizing and latency SLA ask.
- Dedicated capacity ask: AtlasFin requested 2x p4d reserved capacity for production by May; eng needs final workload profile. Confirm action to collect 7-day token peaks and 99p latency.
- Latency spike incident last week: root cause tracked to KV cache eviction pattern on long-tail jobs. Ticket CS-3421 -> eng SRE triage. Need status update and ETA for mitigation.
- Usage & adoption: daily token consumption 2.8M tokens/day (avg), peak 4.9M/day last Tue. Key product areas: fraud detection pipeline + customer-facing summaries.
- Feature asks: streaming responses + tool-calling reliability for summaries. Product asked for more concrete examples to prioritize.

Notes / data points to have on call:
- MRR / ARR: $120k MRR, $1.44M ARR (source: Salesforce snapshot 2026-03-10)
- Trial -> paid conversion: 62% for new teams last 90d
- Support tickets open: 3 (one high latency/regression, one embedding quality, one auth rotation)
- Open Jira: CS-3421 (latency), CS-3475 (embedding regression), INFRA-1290 (private deploy config)

Questions for Tyler (talking points):
1) What did you hear from AtlasFin CSM and engineering on the Dedicated sizing ask? Any urgency changes?
2) Do we have a committed POC date for private VPC networking? They asked at exec level; need ETA to bring compliance/solutions in.
3) Pricing pushback: they asked for a 15% discount on reserved capacity - how far can we go before needing pricing approval?
4) Are we aligned on who will present as the tech lead on the executive renewal call? (Recommend: Priya + Tyler)

Risks & escalation map:
- Risk: If latency mitigation takes >3 weeks, AtlasFin may pause new production rollouts -> could reduce ARR growth. Escalation: raise to Priya Nair (CS Lead) and Eng TPM (Liam Chen).
- Risk: Pricing concession request without case study of cost savings -> loop AE manager for approval. Ticket for pricing approval in SF: OPPS-8872.

Draft agenda for Wed account sync (30m):
1) Quick status (5m): wins since last week (embedding accuracy improvement, demo completed)
2) Dedicated sizing ask (8m): share workload profile + next steps for infra scheduling
3) Latency incident update (7m): current mitigations + timeline for permanent fix
4) Renewal timeline & exec alignment (5m): confirm attendees and next exec prep call
5) AOB / action items (5m)

Action items (owner | due):
- Samira: Pull last 14 days of token usage by route (fraud, summaries) and 99/95/50p latency; share CSV with Tyler + eng by 2026-03-18.
- Tyler: Confirm AtlasFin exec attendees and send proposed exec call times; draft renewal negotiation priorities by 2026-03-19.
- Priya: Start pricing approval thread with finance for potential 15% concession; include ARR impact model; owner Priya, due 2026-03-20.
- Eng (Liam Chen): Provide ETA for KV cache mitigation and patch candidate; update CS-3421 by 2026-03-19.
- Solutions (Diego Ramirez): Prep private VPC checklist and compliance summary for AtlasFin; due 2026-03-24.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this 1:1 focused on unblockers for AtlasFin. Avoid getting pulled into low-level infra detail; request eng to own that update.
- Bring up potential case study ask if they agree to 12 month reserved commit. Could be a lever for discount.
- Remember to ask Tyler about his pipeline bandwidth - he may need additional AE cover for upcoming exec outreach.

Follow-ups after 1:1 (planned):
- Send recap email to AtlasFin thread and internal stakeholders with agreed owners and dates (Samira) within 24h.
- Add dedicated capacity sizing doc to Confluence and tag eng/sre for review: /display/CS/AtlasFin+Dedicated+Sizing

Quick tick-box checklist for the 1:1 (things I want to have open during call):
- Usage CSV (ready) [ ]
- Jira CS-3421 status (open) [ ]
- Exec attendee list from Tyler (received) [ ]
- Pricing sketch / concession bandwidth (talk points) [ ]

Misc fragments / brainstorming (notes to self):
- If they push for immediate Dedicated start, propose 6-month interim reserved with 1mo ramp to full capacity -> reduces risk and gives us time to model their peaks.
- Could offer extended logging retention add-on instead of deeper discount to preserve gross margin.

End of doc.
